name: torch-declared-demo
notes: The ADR-0025 declared-model seam: the DOCUMENT names the nn.Module (torch.nn:Linear + its constructor kwargs) AND the optimizer (torch.optim:Adam + its own knobs) — swapping either is a config edit, never a subclass. Per-epoch telemetry streams through the node's log while it runs and lands complete in training_curve.json beside the model. DeclaredPredict restores the exact fit from the sidecar-verified artifact, cross-checking the declared module by value.

market.notes: the same synthetic market the torch-linear demo trains on

qhat.notes: optimizer is an import path with optimizer_params as its kwargs; lr stays the node's own knob (declaring it inside optimizer_params refuses). The objective is the same doorway: loss is an import path (default torch.nn.functional:mse_loss — this run's objective) with loss_params as ITS kwargs, so Huber at its own delta is 'loss': 'torch.nn:HuberLoss', 'loss_params': {'delta': 0.05} — a document edit, never a subclass. The per-epoch curve is written to artifacts/qhat/training_curve.json.

predict.notes: declaring the module here is a cross-check against the sidecar — a different family refuses by name (spell it exactly as the trainer did; the check is by value)
